headline: Crude oil and gas prices rise following tanker mine strikes in Strait of Hormuz
summary: Oil and natural gas prices climbed after multiple crude oil tankers caught fire from sea mine explosions in the Strait of Hormuz amid escalating regional conflict.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical maritime energy bottleneck, handling a fifth of global petroleum supply.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Navigational hazards in the Strait of Hormuz threaten global crude oil shipments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Explosions damaging crude tankers raised risk premiums across global oil and natural gas benchmarks.
